articles.summary: Cybersecurity tools protect networks, applications and devices, but what about the electronics underneath them? This article explores why hardware, firmware and supply-chain integrity belong inside the cybersecurity model, and how electronics assurance extends security down to the silicon.
articles.title: Cybersecurity Doesn't Stop at IT or OT: Taking Security Down to the Silicon

articles.summary: See how Palitronica supports NIST SP 800-171 requirements with independent hardware and firmware verification, helping defense manufacturers detect undocumented changes, strengthen supply chain assurance, and generate objective evidence throughout the electronics lifecycle.
articles.title: Strengthen NIST SP 800-171 Supply Chain Assurance for Defense Electronics
